editorial:
Imagine spending all your time building a business only to realize your house is empty during the holidays. That is exactly where you find Christina, a hardworking shop owner who has totally ignored her love life. She decides to take a huge gamble by going on twelve dates in the twelve weeks before Christmas. It is a cozy, feel-good story that captures that frantic holiday energy. You will love watching her struggle through some really awkward encounters while trying to figure out what she actually wants in a partner. The vibe is light, sweet, and perfect for a rainy afternoon with a blanket.

The acting feels natural, and the pacing keeps you moving through the dates without feeling bored. While the plot is a bit predictable, the charm comes from the relatable moments of dating failure. If you want something low-stress and heartwarming, you should definitely give this a try.
endingExplained: After a string of bad dates, Christina realizes that the perfect man was right in front of her the whole time. She finds out that her friend and support system is the one she truly loves. They finally admit their feelings for each other in a sweet moment just as Christmas arrives. Everything wraps up with a happy ending where she balances her career and her new relationship, proving that love happens when you least expect it.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves cute holiday romances and stories about finding love.
